title: Payments Operations Note: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Records and the Date Lateness Is Counted From on Parking Agreements
content:
**Rule.** For a late fee on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement, days late are counted from the agreement's delinquency date — the due date of the oldest unpaid period of the current delinquency cycle — unless the agreement's own Bluegate AutoPay Authorization records say otherwise:

1. where an AutoPay draft on this agreement for that due date was declined for insufficient funds, days late are counted from the date of the latest such declined attempt;
2. where no draft on this agreement for that due date was so declined but the agreement's AutoPay authorization stands suspended, they are counted from its suspension date;
3. in every other case they are counted from the delinquency date.

**Days late** are the calendar days from the date lateness is counted from to the handling date, less the grace period days of the class (5 days; 7 days for the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage), and never fewer than zero.

**Records read.** The Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on this parking agreement: each draft's due date, draft date and result (declined for insufficient funds), and the authorization's status (suspended) and suspension date. Drafts on other agreements, and declines for other reasons, are not read for item 1.

### Questions and answers (hypothetical dates, 5-day grace period, handling date 30 June)

*Q. The oldest unpaid period fell due 1 June; drafts for 1 June were declined for insufficient funds on 1 June and again on 8 June.* Lateness is counted from 8 June, the latest declined attempt: 22 calendar days less the 5 grace days, that is 17 days late.

*Q. No declined draft for 1 June, but the authorization was suspended on 12 June.* Counted from 12 June: 18 calendar days less the 5 grace days, that is 13 days late.

*Q. No AutoPay authorization on the agreement.* Counted from the delinquency date, 1 June: 29 calendar days less the 5 grace days, that is 24 days late.

*Q. A draft for 1 June was declined for an expired card and the authorization is active.* Item 1 reads only insufficient-funds declines and item 2 needs a suspension, so lateness is counted from 1 June.
